title.zh: 将马斯巴特省 马斯巴特市镇 Malinta 小学的名称变更为Enrique Legaspi，Sr. 小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Malinta Elementary School in the Municipality of Masbate, Province of Masbate, to Enrique Legaspi, Sr. Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Malinta Elementary School in the Municipality of Masbate, Province of Masbate, to Enrique Legaspi, Sr. Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Malinta tại Thị trấn Masbate, Tỉnh Masbate thành Trường tiểu học Enrique Legaspi, Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Malinta ในเทศบาล Masbate, จังหวัด Masbate เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Enrique Legaspi, Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Malinta di Kotamadya Masbate, Provinsi Masbate menjadi Sekolah Dasar Enrique Legaspi, Sr.
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Malinta di Perbandaran Masbate, Wilayah Masbate menjadi Sekolah Rendah Enrique Legaspi, Sr.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5626_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Malinta Elementary School in the Municipality of Masbate, Province of Masbate, is hereby changed to Enrique Legaspi, Sr. Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
